spans.s:
r. 6th cl. (खुरति)
To cut, to scratch.

m. (-रः)
1 A hoof, a horse's hoof, &c.
2 A razor.
3 The foot of a bedstead; also क्षुर.
4 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish, and of the shape of a hoof.
E.
खुर to cut, रन् Uṇādi affix, the radical र is dropped.

m. (-कः)
A plant, commonly Tilā.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-कः)
An animal in general.
E.
खुर to cut, and आक aff.

m. (-पः)
A kick, kicking.
E.
खुर, and क्षेप throwing.

mfn. (-णाः-णाः-णः)
Flat-nosed, having a nose like a horse's hoof.
E.
खुर a hoof, and नस् deriv. of नासिका a nose; also with a final vowel खुरणस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं).

f. (-वी)
A horse's foot marks.
E.
खुर, and पदवी vestige.

m. (-प्रः)
An arrow with a semicircular head: see क्षुरप्र.

f. (-ली)
Military exercise, practising archery, &c.
E.
खुर to cut, अलच् aff.

m. (-तः)
A kick.
E.
खुर, and आघात a blow.

m. (-तः)
1 A kick.
2 Kicking, pawing, (as a horse.)
E.
खुर, and अभिघात, striking.

m. (-कः)
An iron arrow.
E.
खुर a razor, and अल what is able, affix कन्.

m. (-कः)
1 A barber's case.
2 An iron arrow.
3 A pillow.
E.
खुर a razor, &c. अल to be equal to, affix ठक्; some read this खरालक, but to all appearance erroneously.

r. 1st cl. (खुर्दते or खूर्दते)
To play, to sport.

r. 1st cl. (खूर्दते)
To play: see खुर्द.
